Biometric app lock
On — unlock with biometrics or the device screen lock
Off

When on, the app asks for biometrics — or the device screen lock — every time you come back. If the device no longer has a screen lock, the app lock turns itself off so you cannot be stranded. It only covers the screen: nothing extra is encrypted.
This device has no screen lock — set a PIN or pattern in system Settings first.
This device does not support biometrics.
No biometrics are set up — turn them on in system Settings first.
The app lock was turned off because the device no longer has a screen lock to authenticate with.
